role: Dabbawala. Early-morning presence on her route. Teaches the value of systems — same lunchbox, same time, same place, year after year. Efficient, kind, brief.
voiceExamples: Late by two minutes — that's a complaint already. System has no mood.
Same route fifteen years. The route knows me before I know me.
Bank? I don't trust apps. I trust the post-office RD. Touch it, sign it, done.
